svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: canfuel — real copper, with the four harness nets highlighted
Tracks, vias, pads and pours drawn from canfuel.kicad_pcb, turned to the same way up as the 1:1 paper print. Everything not on the four nets is greyed out.
J1 / J2 as they sit on this drawing
The right-hand column is the one nearer
the board edge — that is the power pair.
The blue wash is the SGND pour, on
both layers — that is why SGND needs
almost no track of its own.
J1 and J2 are on the same four nets,
so both plugs carry all four wires.
